test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘DISCIPLINE’ is written as ‘DKSCKPLKNG’, ‘REVOLUTION’ is written as ‘RGVQLWTKQN’. How will ‘UNIVERSITY’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Vowels ⇒ (2) is added to position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Consonants ⇒ No change 

So,

 
• ‘DISCIPLINE’ is written as ‘DKSCKPLKNG’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9549abe4fe80cfcac816c34d4b2f8f3f268d047854e00f7f169e9abec8410ef2.png] 

And,

 
• ‘REVOLUTION’ is written as ‘RGVQLWTKQN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbab0b9c79ceb69b5bf58c81582296ac707b5318eb1da51bd658b2fb07c0b014.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘UNIVERSITY’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81aa6995f1dffe5c55937a38c7f52b5f2cded03f18c9909f0dffbed2595f5c52.png] 

​Hence, "**WNKVGRSKTY**" is the correct answer.

7b
